title: Classroom Action ABC
hook: The activity is not finished until the tools are safe and stored.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: clean 3D classroom storybook, colorful supplies, simple desks, isolated objects; visual identity: Classroom Action ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child participating in supervised classroom activities
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: material/tool function plus safe activity boundary
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: retrieval -> exact target -> empty-hand or point gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Classroom Action ABC about activity cycles: choose materials, do an age-appropriate task, stop, clean, store, and reset; action never means grabbing every tool.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child learns that making and studying include setup and cleanup, while powered, staining, pinching, sharp, or digital objects get specific safe roles.
